A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
SLP- 65 is associated with intracellular membranes in resting B cells and requires the amino-terminal 50 residues for this vesicular localization.
SLP- 65 is recruited to intracellular vesicles by protein-lipid and protein-protein interactions and is delivered to the BCR signaling complex upon BCR activation to facilitate BCR signaling.
